description: This file defines the TenantClientFactory interface in Java, which provides factory methods to create tenant clients for Hono's Credentials API. It declares static methods to instantiate the factory with or without caching support, and an abstract method to obtain a tenant client asynchronously.

classes.name: TenantClientFactory
classes.description: A factory interface for creating tenant clients for Hono's Credentials API, providing static methods for instantiation and a method to get or create tenant clients asynchronously.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static method that creates a TenantClientFactory instance with a given HonoConnection and no cache provider.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static method that creates a TenantClientFactory instance with a given HonoConnection and CacheProvider, allowing cache configuration.

methods.name: getOrCreateTenantClient
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves or creates a tenant client, returning a Future that completes with the client or fails.
